foreground.footprint: Original RGB max/min at the same pixel coordinates; no high-pass extraction of displayed texture, erosion or relocation. Bright-core landmarks partition colors only.
foreground.spatialColor: Each observed core takes one nearest source LED state; diffuse halo blends neighboring source states. Neutral core highlights preserve original saturation profile.
foreground.exposure: 1.25*sqrt(source maximum / per-effect global source maximum), capped at 255; source-off is exactly zero.
foreground.boundary: Connected actual material silhouette from GrabCut with documented seeds, filled rotor interiors, 0.65px edge feather; no convex visible plate or fixed 24px collar. Original rotor interiors remain static artwork.
foreground.motion: Original RGB generated background phases reused; transport uses distance outside actual silhouette. Original foreground and effect/helper source files remain unchanged.
